status: Verified research candidate; not registered in the active prototype

crop.selection: Full-raster search: 14.5–15.5 degrees, at least four suspicious slope inputs, all-finite 50x50 crop. Prefer more suspicious inputs, then distance to15 degrees, then row/column; retain spatially separated candidates. Purposive illustrative selection, not representative sampling or a validated rover threshold.

height_datum.note: Official NAC processing guide: add 1737400 m to NAC DEM heights to obtain radius. No offset is applied to this crop.

height_policy: Original float32 DEM elevations in metres. No resampling, filling, smoothing or vertical offset.
quality_policy: Original CONF.IMG category codes. Not percentages, uncertainties or Hallmark origin labels. Code 3 does not establish interpolation.

quality_code_definitions.3: Suspicious (edge, corner, did not correlate, etc.)
